fact: The Springer study says the Somali Ministry of Education has recently taken steps to close education system gaps through EMIS application, and surveys 210 users on its effectiveness.

The World Bank amendment to Grant D837-SO describes project support for operationalization and expansion of the EMIS, and expansion of the Teacher Management Information System integrated with the EMIS.
The Joint Education Sector Review report of the Ministry of Education says it incorporates quantitative data from the Education Management Information System (EMIS).
GPE says the EMIS, initiated in 2016 by MOECHE, collects and analyzes data from schools on an annual basis, and all primary schools in the Federal Member States and Banaadir are registered in it.

The World Bank restructuring paper says the EMIS platform piloted by MoECHE has become functional and technically sound, with EMIS enhancement and integration of an enhanced Teacher Management Information System planned for delivery in April 2026.
